reward_rule: reward 1 iff the three test functions return (tests/test.sh runs only /tests/test_outputs.py and writes 1 on pytest rc 0)

cases.why: positive control: the captured solve.sh run unmodified in the image-equivalent environment (python 3.11, pandas 2.2.3, pyarrow 17.0.0) writes both files
do-nothing: /app empty; the existence test asserts, the two value tests open a missing file
solve run, then conflicts.json removed: the parquet test is independent of the report
the report keeps only the name conflict of user 101 (total 1): the email check is guarded by `if email_conflicts:` and nothing counts the conflicts, so an under-reporting report passes
solve's report with the email conflict's selected value set to the source_b value: the guarded email check runs and fails
merged rows of users 102 and 103 carry wrong name and email and the status column is dropped: only users 101 and 104 are content-checked
user_id cast to float64: {101.0,...} == {101,...} and df['user_id'] == 101 still select, so the integer-type requirement is unchecked
user_id cast to str: the set comparison with ints fails
created_date stored as datetime64: a Timestamp does not equal the string '2024-01-15'
created_date as YYYY/MM/DD strings: the exact string comparison fails
total_conflicts 2 while the list holds 3: the length check fails
the email conflict's values dict lacks source_a: the grader indexes it and raises KeyError (an error, not an assertion)
user 101 row taken from source_b (john@b.com, 2024-01-10): the user-101 checks fail
conflict user_id serialised as the string '101': no conflict matches the int 101
merged parquet holds user 101 twice (5 rows): the row-count check fails
merged_users.parquet holds CSV bytes: pyarrow refuses the file (no parquet magic) with ArrowInvalid
report with total_conflicts 0 and an empty list: the >= 1 check fails
